name: Rey's 690 light freighter
description: Rey's 690 light freighter was a freighter that crashed on Jakku sometime before the Battle of Starkiller Base. It was found by the scavenger Rey, who planned to repair it and sell it to Niima Outpost junk boss, Unkar Plutt. Rey was assisted in the repairs by fellow scavengers Devi and Strunk, who ultimately stole the ship.
